goal.text: The user is keeping an honest tally of this foosball match and wants to confirm how many times he broke off to the scoreboard and whether the score was actually changed.

turns.text: Left hand on the scoreboard just then, or did I switch?

trigger.detail: the sideways step and reach to the scoreboard finished and he returned to the rods

expected_answer.text: Your left. You stepped sideways off the rods and reached across to the scoreboard with that hand.

trigger.detail: user acknowledges mid-answer and keeps the floor

expected_answer.text: Mm-hm. You're back on the rods now, working them with both hands.

turns.text: hold on — I meant before that, right at the very beginning: which hand was doing the spinning?

trigger.detail: user repairs the scope of his own earlier question

expected_answer.text: Both of them. Right at the opening you had two hands on the handles, spinning, before you broke away.

turns.text: That's three trips across now, right? Or am I miscounting?

trigger.detail: the third break to the scoreboard ended and both hands came back to the rods

expected_answer.text: Three, yes. One just after the start, one around twenty-five seconds, and the last one near thirty-three.

turns.text: And the last one — did I actually change anything, or just lean on it?

trigger.detail: user cuts in to narrow the tally to the trip that mattered

expected_answer.text: No, only the middle one. You adjusted it then. That last reach you came straight back to the handles.

turns.text: On my left, or my right?

trigger.detail: a long uninterrupted stretch of rod play with no break to the scoreboard

expected_answer.text: On your left. Every time you went for it you stepped left and leaned away from the table to reach.

trigger.detail: a backchannel that escalates into holding the floor

expected_answer.text: Yep. You are still playing, both handles turning.

turns.text: Has it been touched at all since?

trigger.detail: another counter clockwise rotation finished with no break away from the table

expected_answer.text: Not once. Since that third trip you have not left the handles. Everything since has been rod work.

turns.text: oh — by the way, which hand have I been favouring?

trigger.detail: user cuts in with a new angle on the same stretch of play

expected_answer.text: Your left, mostly. Nearly all the counter clockwise turns in the last stretch came from it, with your right holding.

turns.text: sorry, quick one — and what was that just now, off the handles?

trigger.detail: both hands came off the rods and went up to his face

expected_answer.text: You took both hands off and brought them up to your face, then put them straight back on.
